initialization_methods.description: How the client is initialized in the code based on the chosen mode (Gemini API Key vs. Vertex AI)
initialization_methods.api_key_initialization: const client = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY });
initialization_methods.vertex_ai_initialization: const client = new GoogleGenAI({ vertexai: true, project: process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, location: process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION || 'global' });

core_methods.example_call: const response = await client.models.generateContent({ model: 'gemini-3.5-flash', contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'Your prompt here' }] }], config: { temperature: 0.7, maxOutputTokens: 800 } });

core_methods.purpose: Generate vector embeddings for semantic memory
core_methods.example_call: const response = await client.models.embedContent({ model: 'gemini-embedding-001', contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'Text to embed' }] }] });

core_methods.purpose: Generate images for the avatar/studio engine
core_methods.example_call: const response = await client.models.generateImages({ model: 'gemini-3.1-flash-image', prompt: 'photorealistic portrait of a helper avatar...', config: { numberOfImages: 1, outputMimeType: 'image/jpeg' } });
